summary: Verified the MapWidget.tsx web-platform fix for the user complaint 'not even able to locate one PFZ'. On web preview, Platform.OS==='web' now renders WebMarkerList instead of the dead-end WebView spinner. Tested 'Where is the nearest Potential Fishing Zone today?' across 3 regions (Kakinada, Mumbai, Kochi) via Region Switcher - each showed a distinct, readable, color-coded (green PFZ dots, white user location) marker list with correct region-specific zone names and lat/lon coords rounded to 4 decimals (Kakinada Bay Mouth/Hope Island Shelf; Uran Bank/Colaba Point Bank/Versova Shelf; Kochi Harbour Mouth/Vypin Shelf/Alappuzha Deep). Hint text 'Interactive map renders in the mobile app (Expo Go)...' displays correctly. No 'Map failed to load' or spinner timeout observed - bug is RESOLVED for the web preview surface. Sanity pass: chat streaming, verdict/safety badges, reasoning trace (7-step, expandable), sources citations, Alerts tab (active hazards + notifications), Saved tab (saved locations with Ask/Geofence actions), and language switcher (EN->Telugu, clean glyph rendering, no console errors) all confirmed working with zero regressions. Metro/expo logs clean, zero browser console errors captured across all test runs.

react_native_issues.issue: Minor/cosmetic: marker list dot color-coding only differentiates PFZ (green) vs user (white); no hazard/route_unsafe (red) marker appeared in any of the 3 tested PFZ queries to visually confirm the red-dot styling on web, since PFZ answers only return pfz-kind markers. Code review confirms markerColor() correctly maps route_unsafe/hazard to colors.error (red), consistent with native buildHtml() logic, so this is very likely correct but not visually observed in this pass since no hazard-map query was tested.

action_items: LOW: Optionally test a chat query that returns a hazard/restricted-zone map widget (e.g. safety/geofence question) to visually confirm the red dot renders correctly in WebMarkerList on web, closing out full color-coding verification.
No blocking issues. The core reported bug (web preview cannot locate PFZ) is confirmed fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: MapWidget.tsx: Platform.OS==='web' branch cleanly short-circuits before the WebView/MapLibre code path, avoiding wasted asset-loading calls (loadMapLibs useEffect also early-returns when isWeb) - efficient, no dead network/asset calls on web.

WebMarkerList correctly reuses widget.markers with proper key (`${m.label}-${i}`), formats coords via toFixed(4), and color-codes via shared markerColor() helper mirroring the native buildHtml() marker color logic - no logic duplication drift risk observed.
Native (non-web) WebView code path is untouched by this change, consistent with the fix scope described.
